decisions.rationale: Incineroar (35% HP) is the opponent's final Pokémon. Goodra-Hisui at -2 SpA deals 22.8-42.4% with STAB Draco Meteor (choice 3). An outright KO or leaving Incineroar low enough that Flare Blitz recoil faints Incineroar gives us the win. Protecting only delays action.

Bringing four that pressured Zard while they left Garganacl (Wide Guard) and Clefable home meant nothing blocked the decisive Rock
reflections.adjustment: Expect a game-3 counter-pick: Garganacl (Wide Guard) to shield Zard from Rock Slide, or Clefable Follow Me. Prep single-target answers — Metagross Meteor Mash (2x SE vs Garga), Mamoswine Ice Shard instead of spread — and use Aerodactyl Taunt on Garganacl (Purifying Salt doesn't block Taunt) to shut off Recover/Wide Guard; keep baiting their Protect cadence and only fire Rock Slide once Wide Guard is Taunted or Garga is off-field.
reflections.notebook: Series vs sun squad, tied 1-1. They own Zard-Y/Venu/Garganacl/Pult/Goodra-H/Clef. SPEED: Pult <=213 > Aero 200 > Zard-Y <=167 > Meta 130-162 > Venu <=132 (sun ~264) > Goodra/Clef <=112 > Mamo 102 > Garga <=87. CONFIRMED g2: (1) Meta-sack trades for Pult — Incin Lariat KO'd Pult from 90% (full-HP OHKO likely, not proven); (2) full-HP Mamo survives no-sun Zard Overheat at ~6% (max roll) via Thick Fat — safe RS retaliation; (3) Incin FB KOs Goodra-H from ~40%; (4) opp double-Protects under pressure and will burn their own sun turns doing it — keep baiting Protect, strike on cadence reset. OPP ADAPTATION RISK g3: they left Garga+Clef home in g2 and lost to RS — expect Garga Wide Guard (blocks RS+EQ) or Clef Follow Me next. COUNTERS: Aero Taunt beats Garga (Purifying Salt blocks status, NOT Taunt); Meta Mash 2x SE vs Garga; prefer single-target Ice Shard/Mash over spread until Wide Guard neutralized; RS spread still beats Follow Me. KNOWN KITS: Goodra-H MIN Spe 80, low bulk, Sap Sipper, Sitrus, FC 2x SE vs Aero/Mamo. Zard-Y Timid: can't OHKO healthy Incin; in-sun HW/Overheat threatens Mamo — only attack Zard with Mamo when sun is down. Venu: Sash, no Protect, sun Weather Ball=Fire, Sleep Powder — Fake Out+Taunt denies. Pult: Ghost (Fake Out immune), LO Shadow Ball OHKOs Meta. Clef: Unaware, Follow Me, Babiri. Garga: Body Press 2x SE vs Mamo+Incin; Salt Cure 2x SE vs Aero. PLAN g3: preserve RS users for Zard; no spread into Wide Guard; Parting Shot dead with empty bench; Meta's best use may again be Pult bait unless Garga comes (then save Mash for it).

reflections.summary: Evolving Charizard into Mega Charizard Y set Drought, which boosted opponent Incineroar's Flare Blitz to KO Goodra-Hisui while Mamoswine's Thick Fat allowed it to survive Charizard's Overheat and retaliate with a game-ending Rock Slide.
reflections.adjustment: Do not bring Charizard-Mega-Y into Mamoswine and Incineroar; instead, lead Venusaur for Sleep Powder pressure and preserve Dragapult to handle Metagross and control speed without boosting Incineroar's damage.
reflections.notebook: Opponent prioritizes fast physical pressure (Aerodactyl, Metagross-Mega, Mamoswine) alongside Incineroar support. Mamoswine has Thick Fat, dampening Fire moves and punishing Sun. Dragapult outspeeds and OHKOs Metagross-Mega with Life Orb Shadow Ball. Avoid setting Sun when Incineroar and Mamoswine are present.
